description: Secteurs des centres d'entretien routier (CER) du département de la Manche is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Delimitation of the scope of action of the Channel Road Maintenance Centres (RECs). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Sectors of road maintenance centres (CER) of the department of Manche" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes, conseil départemental, centre d'entretien, département, cd50, cer. The listing shows 2017-04-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
